sloka: अनरण्यात् पृथुः जज्ञे त्रिशंकुः तु पृथोः सुतः ।त्रिशंकोः अभवत् पुत्रो धुन्धुमारः महायशाः ॥१-७०-२४॥
transliteration: anaraṇyāt pṛthuḥ jajñe triśaṁkuḥ tu pṛthoḥ sutaḥ ।triśaṁkoḥ abhavat putro dhundhumāraḥ mahāyaśāḥ ॥1-70-24॥

translations.english: Bana's son was the most brilliant and valiant Anaranya whose son Pruthu was succeeded by Trisanku.
